simple.meaning: to braid , i.e. intermix ; technically, to traffic (as if by barter); also or give to be security (as a kind of exchange)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עָרַב (H6148) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

simple.summary: עָרַב (ʻârab) means to braid , i.e. intermix ; technically, to traffic (as if by barter); also or give to be security (as a kind of exchange) First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 18 23.

definitions.short: to braid , i.e. intermix ; technically, to traffic (as if by barter); also or give to be security (as a kind of exchange)
definitions.usage: engage, (inter-) meddle (with), mingle (self), mortgage, occupy, give pledges, be(-come, put in) surety, undertake.
definitions.full: H6148. arab II. עָרַב verb take on pledge, give in pledge, exchange (Late Hebrew go surety for (rare); Phoenician ערב surety ; Old Aramaic ערבא pledge ; עֲרַב ᵑ7 , Syriac , go surety for ; usually identified with I. ערב — mix, exchange, pledge — but quite uncertain; compare Buhl Lex Lag BN 203 ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ע Gen 44:32 4 t.; 2 masculine singular עָרַבְתָּ Prov 6:1 ; Imperfect 1singular suffix אֶעֶרְבֶנּוּ Gen 43:9 ; Imperative עֲרֹב Psa 119:122 , suffix עָרְבֵנִי Isa 38:14 , so Job 17:3 (but see below); Infinitive construct לַעֲרֹב Ezek 27:9 ; Participle עֹרֵב Prov 17:18 , etc.; — 1 with accusative of person taken on pledge , i.e. go surety for the safety of, Gen 43:9 (J), 44:32 (J; + מֵעִם person); for the debts of Prov 11:15 ; 20:16 ; 27:13 ; of God Isa 38:14 go surety for me , Psa 119:122 , so Job 17:3 (si vera lectio, see עֵרָבוֺן ); accusative of person omitted, ׳ע לְ Prov 6:1 go surety to one (in behalf of another, || כַּמֶּ֑יךָ לַזָּר תָּקַע ); with accusative of thing 22:26 (|| תֹּקְעֵיכָֿ֑ף ). 2 give in pledge , with accusative of thing Neh 5:3 (i.e. mortagage), figurative ׳ע אֶתלִֿבּוֺ Jer 30:21 so ׳ע רֵעֵהוּ לִפְנֵי עֲרֻבָּה Prov 17:18 (|| כָּ֑ף תֹּקֵעַ ). 3 exchange (in trade), with accusative of congnate meaning with verb מָעֲרָבֵךְ Ezek 27:9 , 27 . Hithpa`el 1. reciprocal: Imperative אֶתאֲֿדֹנִי נָא הִתְעָ֫רֶב 2Kin 18:23 exchange pledges (make a bargain) with my lord = Isa 36:8 . 2. a. have fellowship with, בְּ person, Perfect 3plural הִתְעָֽרְבוּ Ezra 9:2 ; Imperfect 3masculine plural וַיִּתְעָֽרְבוּ Psa 106:35 ; 2 masculine singular תִּתְעָרָ֑ב with לְ person Prov 20:19 , with עִם person 24:21 . b. share in, בְּ of thing, 3 masculine singular יִתְעָרַב Prov 14:10 in his joy no other shares. .
